_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: MyTimetableMenu, MyLearningRecordMenu — the learner self-service section.

pages.title: Learning record exports
pages._note: portable-learning-record: read-only history of LearningRecordExport rows — a learner-initiated, signed, dual-shaped bundle of the learner's own trajectory. No create/edit actions beyond the declarative generate lifecycle action.

pages.title: Learning record export
pages._note: portable-learning-record: renders one LearningRecordExport's coverageReport (naming every source object's included/summarized/omitted outcome), bundle reference, signature, and issuer DID. lifecycleActions expose generate (requested → generated) as a button.

pages.title: Learning record shares
pages._note: portable-learning-record: read-only history of LearningRecordShare rows — a time-boxed, revocable grant of one generated export to a named external recipient. No create/edit actions beyond the declarative grant/revoke lifecycle actions.

pages.title: Learning record share
pages._note: portable-learning-record: renders one LearningRecordShare's recipient, expiry, revocation, and access-tracking data plus a Related panel resolving the shared LearningRecordExport. lifecycleActions expose grant/revoke as buttons.

pages.title: Learning record imports
pages._note: portable-learning-record: read-only history of LearningRecordImport rows — a coordinator-facing, evidence-only report of an applicant-uploaded prior-institution bundle during Application intake. No create/edit actions beyond the declarative parse lifecycle action.

pages.title: Learning record import
pages._note: portable-learning-record: renders one LearningRecordImport's verificationStatus and entries[] table (mirrors CoursePackageImportReportDetail's entries table, applied to the input side) plus a Related panel resolving the Application it is evidence for. lifecycleActions expose parse as a button.

pages.title: My learning record
pages._note: portable-learning-record: the learner's aggregate dashboard — LearningRecordAggregationService's live composition, read-only, plus the export action (generate + coverage report + download link) and a share panel (create with mandatory expiry, list, revoke). Mirrors CoursePackageImportView/SkillsGapDashboard's bar for a genuine non-CRUD interaction; no PHP CRUD controller beyond the read-only /api/learning-records/me composition endpoint.

pages.title: Verify learning record share
pages._note: portable-learning-record: public verification page for a LearningRecordShare's shared bundle, modeled directly on the existing CredentialVerify page's minimal, anonymous-verifier shape. Calls the public GET /api/learning-record-shares/{id}/verify endpoint — never a session-authenticated OR object read. type='custom' pages have no manifest-level `mode` (that key only applies to type='detail'/'form'); the underlying PageController#index/#catchAll route is `@NoAdminRequired` (not `#[PublicPage]`), so reaching this SPA route today still requires an NC session — the identical, pre-existing limitation CredentialVerify's own 'anonymous proof page' already carries, not a regression introduced here.

pages.title: My learning
pages._note: Learner-facing home surface (enrolled courses, progress, next activities); no generic lib index/detail analogue.

pages.title: My timetable
pages._note: personal-timetable: the signed-in user's own week view. A bespoke component (no generic lib index/detail analogue) rendering the caller's OWN Session objects for a window, resolved server-side from cohort membership (teacher/learner) and RBAC-scoped via ObjectService. Read-only — clicking a session deep-links to SessionDetail; no create/edit here.
